title: AgentDeck: your coding agents, in your pocket
description: Start, steer and approve Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any ACP agent running on your own computer, from your phone. End-to-end encrypted, open source.
ogDescription: Control Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any ACP agent on your computer from your phone. End-to-end encrypted.
heroLead: Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any ACP agent on your own computer. Start, steer and approve it from your phone, wherever you are.
mockMe: The login e2e test fails on CI about 1 in 5 runs. Find out why and fix it.
mockAgent: The test waits a fixed 500 ms for the redirect. On slow CI runners that isn't enough. I'll wait for the URL instead.
mockPermDesc: Claude wants to verify the fix.
featuresTitle: Built for being away from the keyboard
featuresSub: Your agent keeps working on your computer. You keep it moving from the couch, the train or a meeting.
notifyDesc: Get a push notification when a task finishes or your agent needs you.
approveDesc: Allow or deny permission requests and answer your agent's questions in a tap.
voiceDesc: Push-to-talk voice chat, with a short spoken summary of every reply.
agentsDesc: Switch between agents, models and modes. Built on the open Agent Client Protocol.
reviewDesc: Browse files, Git changes, diffs and history. Preview the pages, charts and maps your agent builds.
liveDesc: See the iOS Simulator, Android emulator or browser tab your agent is driving, in real time.
demoSub: From installing the daemon to approving a change on the phone.
startTitle: Up and running in a minute
startSub: A free agent is built in, so you can try it without an account or an API key.
installDesc: On the computer where your agents run. macOS, Linux and Windows.
runDesc: It runs in the background and starts with your computer. No open ports, no VPN.
scanDesc: Scan the QR code it prints with the AgentDeck app, then pick an agent. Choose $1<Free> to start right away.
securityTitle: Your code stays on your machine
securitySub: Phone and computer pair with a secret ID from the QR code and derive encryption keys from it. The relay only ever sees ciphertext, and you can $1<host it yourself>. No accounts, no analytics, no tracking.
ctaSub: Free and open source under the MIT license.
